text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here we are! The battle to crown the 
spring mile champion, the Yasuda Kinen! 
This year—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A super star-studded field! Unlike the 
slightly thinned-out Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen, heavyweights from both sprint and 
mile distances have gathered in force!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital, the hero who conquered both 
turf and dirt. And...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Specializing from mile to medium 
distances— Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A super star-studded lineup, heck yeah! 
Aaargh, just standing here is making me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm so utterly blessed, I feel like I'm 
ascending... Motivation boosted, ready to 
pounce!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If it's about motivation, I've got plenty 
too...! I'll go head-to-head with them and 
show what I'm made of!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion, fresh off her break. And the 
one to watch above all else is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Believe! Regarded by many as one of the 
strongest contenders on the sprint 
circuit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you♪ Let's 
not push ourselves too hard for today.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Please.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san... was strong last year too. 
But this year—she's on a whole other 
level.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
She's honed that razor-sharp burst to its 
absolute limit. If she unleashes it all at 
once, I wonder if I'll be able to hold 
out...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Still... I won't give it up. With Daitaku 
Helios absent this spring, the pinnacle of 
the sprint division is...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A one-on-one duel between Durandal-san and 
me. I definitely won't let my rhythm be 
broken.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono... I can feel it. 
Believe-san's heartbeat. And—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It seems the Princess is looking forward 
to it as well. To today's decisive battle.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's show them the power of the 
"Holy Sword"!

Yeah, let's show them the power of the 
Holy Sword!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As last year's Mile Championship 
winner, I cannot afford to run an 
embarrassing race.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let us etch it clearly into the public's 
mind: "Here stands our kingdom."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san. I wonder... will you catch 
it today?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Behold my "Holy Sword," shining leagues 
brighter than in the last Sprinters 
Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Come at me, Durandal-san. I'll give 
it everything I have, in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you both have no regrets. Allow 
me, Fine Motion, to bear witness as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Duran & Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout history, the true value of a 
famed sword— is only proven when clashing 
against a worthy foe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Let us put it to the test of the world. 
Whether the blade Durandal and I have 
poured our heart and soul into can hold 
its own against such formidable foes."
